---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md,README.md,.github/**/*.md,AGENTS.md"
---
# Documentation instructions

- Documentation must describe the repository as it actually exists, not an imagined future implementation.
- Record architectural decisions and important changes in `docs/CHANGELOG.md` and update `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md` when the current phase changes.
- Keep setup commands copy/paste friendly for Windows developers.
- Do not put real credentials, API keys, database passwords, or private customer information in documentation.
